title: acer caudatum var. multiserratum
intro: Acer caudatum var. multiserratum, commonly known as Korean maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer caudatum var. multiserratum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research has identified the presence of bioactive compounds like kaempferol, quercetin, and rutin, which are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
